meta.decision: D-14 (capture), D-06 (vcc is inert on the wire)
meta.how_to_update: This file is a pre-Phase-148 capture and must NOT be regenerated to make a failure disappear -- a diff here means the host->wire contract moved, which Phase 148 is specifically forbidden to do. A legitimate future wire change must re-capture deliberately and say in the commit message which chips and which keys moved.
meta.why_nine_keys: The union across all 746 chips is exactly nine keys (algorithm, bus-config, chip-id, flags, memory-size, page-size, pin-count, pulse-delay, vpp_mv). A five-key capture -- the number D-06/D-14 assumed -- would miss bus-config, flags and page-size, three real wire fields (RESEARCH F-8).
